scope: Final visual spot audit. The review sampled PDF contact sheets and full-size PDF and Word pages. It did not inspect every page at full size.

criteria.typeface_and_hierarchy: Pass in sampled Word and PDF pages. The title and headings have clear hierarchy. The final Word title has no blue border or rule.
criteria.visible_question_codes: Pass in sampled practice pages. No visible source question codes appear.
criteria.selective_emphasis: Pass in sampled pages. Bold, italics, and heading weights distinguish key terms, limits, answers, and section labels.
criteria.semantic_colors: Pass in sampled pages. Navy marks headings, teal marks retained decisions, rust marks limits, and blue-gray marks source links.
criteria.paragraph_alignment: Pass in sampled body paragraphs. Text uses justified alignment in the sampled PDF and Word pages.
criteria.line_spacing_and_density: Pass in sampled pages. Body text remains readable at page size. Long Word output spans 651 pages, with readable line spacing in inspected sections.
criteria.question_breaks: Pass in sampled questions. Prompts, options, and answers remain together on sampled Word and practice PDF pages.
criteria.captions_and_figures: Pass with limits. Sampled figures have captions and source links. Dense AWS architecture labels remain small at page size. Captions direct readers to open the source at full size where needed.
criteria.chapter_transitions: Pass in final PDF sample. Chapter 23 starts with its heading and introductory text together on page 121.
criteria.content_integrity: Not assessed. This review checks layout, not factual accuracy or answer-key correctness.

limitations: Contact sheets received visual review at reduced scale. Only the listed pages received full-size review.
The review did not confirm font metadata, accessibility tags, watermark status, or content correctness.
